main.description: Redeem the one-time login code that /callback appended to the frontend's return URL (`#code=...`) for a session. Unauthenticated: the code is the credential. A code works once and for one minute.

session.description: The bearer token to send as `Authorization: Bearer` from now on.

errors.name: InvalidCode
errors.description: The code is unknown, expired, or already used.
